test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of a sentence/paragraph are given below. While the first and the last parts (A and F) are in the correct order, the parts in between are jumbled up. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent sentence/paragraph.**

A. If you complete one of your assignments early

B. do not work on any other assignment

C. go back through that assignment only

D. if you are found working on another assignment

E. this is not permitted

F. Your contract will be terminated .
solution:
The correct answer is: **C, B, E, D **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence begins by establishing a condition (**A**) – "*if you complete one of your assignments early.*"
 
• Then, it provides guidance (**C**) – "*go back through that assignment only.*"
 
• Following this guidance, it advises against working on any other assignment (**B**).
 
• It then explains that doing so is not permitted (**E**).
 
• Finally, it warns of consequences (**D, F**) – "*if you are found working on another assignment, your contract will be terminated.*"
 
• Therefore, the correct sequence is **C, B, E, D**

Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.
